messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate detected for tenant DeltaEdge on Private VPC vpc-0a1b2c3d. NLB target health failing -> ~60% 503s over last 3m. Paging: @oncall-sre-jamie :rotating_light:
oncall-sre-jamie: Reading metrics, starting triage. @netops-lee can you check NLB target health + recent SG changes? :eyes:
netops-lee: Looking now. NLB target group deltaedge-tg shows many targets Unhealthy, HC responses 503 from origin IPs (10.0.2.*). No HC config changes in the last hour.
eng-sre-maya: Any deploys? I'll tail nginx on hosts and check for upstream errors + conntrack saturation.
csd-ana: Customer reported spike in API 5xxs via support ticket #1829. DeltaEdge is on a Private Dedicated pool — high customer impact.
oncall-sre-jamie: No deploys flagged in last 30m from deploy-bot. Observing host-side `upstream prematurely closed connection` in a few nodes.
netops-lee: Found an SG egress rule deployed at 12:03 UTC that tightened outbound CIDR for tenant: `deny-outbound-203.122.0.0/16` per change CHG-4821. Reverting now to test.
netops-lee: Revert applied. Requesting NLB target re-eval. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: System: TG health improved from 38% -> 71% healthy within 90s after SG revert.
eng-sre-maya: Host logs show lots of `conntrack: table full` warnings on the NAT instances fronting the tenant. conntrack counters near limit:
```
# conntrack -L | wc -l
191500
```
oncall-sre-jamie: Conntrack saturation would cause upstream resets and 503s. netops, can we shift tenant to spare NAT pool (nat-pool-2) while we scrub and increase conntrack?
netops-lee: Preparing route table change: update rtb-0f9a... association to point to nat-2. Will push in 30s, expect propagation ~60s.
deploy-bot: Action: route-table-update applied by netops-lee (CL-9987). Diff: `rtb-0f9a` -> target `nat-2`. See: https://deploys.redwood/CL-9987
csd-ana: Informing DeltaEdge of mitigation steps and ETA now.
acctmgr-ron: I'm on the call with DeltaEdge. They asked for ETA for full recovery, please advise when stable >5m.
oncall-sre-jamie: After nat shift: TG health 95%, error rate dropping. Monitoring for sustained stability 10m.
incident-bot: Metrics: 503 error rate reduced from 63% -> 4% over 3m. :chart_with_downwards_trend:
eng-sre-maya: Perma-fix: bumping conntrack max on nat-2 and adding persistent rule to avoid quick re-saturation:
```
essh nat-2 'sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=524288'
```
netops-lee: SG rollback confirmed, nat switch complete, DNS unchanged. No ALB/NLB attribute changes required.
csd-ana: DeltaEdge acknowledged reduced errors and accepts mitigation. They reported a short spike in latency but no data loss.
oncall-sre-jamie: We'll keep monitoring, closing incident if no regression in 30m. Postmortem ticket will capture runbook updates.
eng-sre-maya: Opening postmortem PMT-4021. Will add steps: preflight SG gating, nat-pool failover playbook, conntrack tuning thresholds.
acctmgr-ron: Thanks all — I'll send a customer recap and follow up on SLA credits if needed.
incident-bot: RESOLVED: Mitigation successful at 12:49 UTC. Monitoring window started. Incident thread will be archived after postmortem entry.
